audit.scope: Preparation core uses one value per declared form. All supplied case_fields are preserved, including excess; a mismatch must not be hidden or treated as matched-control evidence.

formulas.primary_records: Number of unique registered primary case paths, not every physical tick.
formulas.preparations: Sum explicit preparation counts; conventional and native categories separated.
formulas.forks: Standalone declared forks plus source-declared nested diagnostic fork operations; no extra preparations fabricated.
formulas.input_receipts: Each primary final receipt once, separated by declared/inferable provenance; inherited receipts across branches are not new experiences.
formulas.readout_projection: Original readout scalars/admission and short unpacked physical excerpts, with original JSON locators; no hidden reclassification.

limitations: Numbers of queries, products, records, worlds and independent histories are different denominators.
Some historical references and preparation-only source tests deliberately lack a reported participant decoder.
The malformed17-value guarded preparation remains in the evidence. Its comparison with the16-value offpath case does not isolate a guard effect.
All scientific interpretation remains provisional and must retain paired controls, resource differences and source-version domains.
